key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:105F4
name: draw_eight_entry_list
description: Draws eight text entries stacked sixteen units apart, each fetched from a buffer by a helper and printed through a graphics library call. It sets the drawing colour before and after the loop and makes a final drawing call using a row index clamped to nine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:1074C
name: clear_panel_and_draw_frame
description: Sets a drawing attribute, clears a fixed rectangle at the top-left of the display area, then draws a boxed frame around a second fixed area through library calls. Only constant coordinates and sizes appear in the code.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:1079E
name: draw_optional_middle_items
description: Sets a drawing attribute and draws three fixed items, the middle one only when the first argument is non-zero. The items are addressed relative to the global data base.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:10806
name: draw_done_and_cancel_labels
description: Prints the four-character label Done only when the flag argument is non-zero, then always prints the six-character label Cancel at a second fixed position. Each label is moved to its position before printing.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:108A2
name: draw_box_from_coordinate_record
description: Copies four coordinate values from a short-word array into a local record, uses the first two to position a drawing call, and passes the record and a constant to a drawing routine. The shape is drawn from stored bounds.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:1091A
name: open_window_or_report_error
description: Opens a display window through a library call and stores its handle. If opening fails it shows the message unable to open a window and returns false.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:10948
name: return_true_stub
description: Returns the value one with no other work, so callers always see success. The code has no side effects.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:10966
name: close_window_and_clear_handle
description: Closes the stored display handle when one is set, releases a resource through a library call with fixed constants, clears the stored handle, and then runs a cleanup routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:1099C
name: load_512_bytes_or_fallback
description: Opens a numbered resource using a 32-byte record and reads up to 512 bytes into the caller's buffer, closing it afterwards. If the open fails it calls a library routine with a fixed value instead.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:109D6
name: call_library_then_succeed
description: Makes one library call with no arguments, calls a second routine, and returns one. Only the call sequence is visible in the code.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:109F4
name: load_512_bytes_after_setup
description: Initialises a 32-byte record, runs a setup routine when a stored flag is zero, then opens a second numbered resource and reads up to 512 bytes into the caller's buffer. Returns whether the resource was opened.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:10A26
name: run_two_steps_return_success
description: Calls two routines in sequence and returns the value one.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:10A44
name: build_chess_saves_name
description: Clears the first byte of the caller's buffer, then fills it with the text ChessSaves through helper routines. The first fill runs only when a stored flag is zero, and the second always runs.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:10A90
name: initialise_record_and_dispatch
description: Zeroes the leading fields of a record, sets one byte to two, stores the caller's third value and a register value into it, then passes the record and the second argument to a helper routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:10AE4
name: init_serial_port_and_interrupts
description: Registers an interrupt handler, points two buffer pointers at the same empty start position, then writes the serial period and the interrupt enable and request registers to configure serial interrupts.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:10B26
name: send_bytes_over_serial
description: Sends a counted run of bytes out the serial data register one at a time. Before each byte it waits until the transmit-ready flag is set, and each byte is written with the ninth data bit set.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:10B4A
name: send_byte_run_until_count
description: Writes bytes from a buffer to the serial data register, waiting for transmit-empty between writes, until a remaining count reaches zero. It sets the same ninth data bit as the other serial send routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:10B5E
name: return_immediately_stub
description: Empty routine that returns at once with no side effects.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:10B66
name: read_serial_bytes_with_timeout
description: Reads a counted number of bytes from the serial receive ring buffer into the caller's buffer, waiting for each one with a timer-based timeout and wrapping the ring pointer at its end. Returns zero when all bytes are read and minus one on timeout.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:10BB0
name: read_serial_bytes_with_deadline
description: Copies bytes from the serial receive ring buffer into the caller's buffer until the count is reached, restarting a timer deadline whenever the buffer is empty. Returns minus one if the deadline passes.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:10BDE
name: read_serial_bytes_until_timeout
description: Copies bytes from the serial receive ring buffer into a caller's buffer, restarting a timer deadline for each byte. It returns minus one when a byte does not arrive before the deadline and zero when the count is exhausted.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:10BE8
name: return_minus_one_stub
description: Returns minus one with no other work, so callers receive a failure result.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:10BEA
name: read_serial_bytes_with_wait
description: Reads a counted run of bytes from the serial receive ring buffer, waiting for each byte in turn with a timer check. Returns minus one when a wait expires and zero once all bytes have been read.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:10BEE
name: return_zero_stub
description: Returns zero with no other work and no side effects.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:10BFC
name: clear_serial_receive_buffer
description: Sets the serial receive read position equal to the write position, discarding any buffered received bytes.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:10C1E
name: count_buffered_serial_bytes
description: Returns how many bytes are waiting in the serial receive ring buffer, computed from its read and write positions and wrapped at a buffer size of 128.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:10C36
name: ring_buffer_position_gap
description: Returns the difference between two ring buffer positions plus 128, the buffer size, so the result stays positive.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:10C54
name: clear_serial_receive_interrupt
description: Clears the pending serial receive interrupt request, then calls a routine with interrupt number eleven and the stored handler.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:10C7E
name: store_received_serial_byte
description: Clears the receive-buffer-full interrupt request, then stores the received byte from the caller's record into the receive ring buffer and advances the write position with wraparound.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:10CAC
name: send_packet_with_retries
description: Builds a two-byte check value from a packet's bytes, sends the packet over the serial link and waits for a reply. It repeats up to five times and shows an error message when no valid reply arrives.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:10D08
name: send_checked_packet_retries
description: Adds a packet's bytes into a two-byte check value, sends the packet and waits for a reply, retrying up to five times. Shows an error when every retry fails.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:10D2C
name: await_reply_with_retries
description: Waits for a reply on the serial link, repeating up to five times. Negative replies cause a stored response to be resent, and an error message is shown when the limit is reached.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:10D4C
name: await_reply_or_report_collision
description: Waits for a reply on the serial link and retries on negative replies. It shows the message that sending happened at the same time and to try again when a reply is unexpected, and an error when retries run out.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:10DBA
name: await_opponent_reply
description: Waits for the opponent's reply over the serial link, retrying up to five times and resending on negative replies. Shows the message that the opponent is not responding when all tries fail.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:10E42
name: dispatch_incoming_serial_message
description: Dispatches an incoming serial message by its first byte. Packet-style messages with a four-character command are checked and answered, plain text lines are cleaned and passed on, and unrecognised bytes are reported as errors. Returns minus one when nothing valid arrives.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:10E72
name: receive_serial_message_loop
description: Repeatedly receives serial messages and handles each one by its first byte, checking and answering packet-style commands and treating other bytes as text lines. Returns minus one if no message arrives in time.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:10E7A
name: await_expected_serial_packet
description: Waits for a serial packet whose command matches one of two accepted types, sending a response for the matched type. Returns zero once an expected packet arrives and minus one if the link goes quiet.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:10E88
name: send_status_then_await_reply
description: Sends one of two fixed status packets chosen by a stored flag, then waits for a reply packet. Returns minus one if no reply arrives.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:10EA2
name: send_packet_until_acknowledged
description: Sends a packet with a fixed command chosen by a stored flag, then waits for a reply and repeats the send while the reply reports an error. Returns minus one when no reply arrives.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:10EAC
name: return_zero_value
description: Returns zero without performing any other operation or accessing memory.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:10EBA
name: handle_serial_message_from_byte
description: Handles a serial message whose first byte has already been read. It sends a response for packet-style commands and treats other bytes as text lines. Returns zero for unknown commands and minus one when no message arrives.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:10EC6
name: await_serial_message_and_reply
description: Waits in a loop for an incoming serial message, checking and answering packet-style commands and treating other bytes as text lines. Returns zero when the command is neither accepted type and minus one when the link goes quiet.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:10ED2
name: send_response_and_await_message
description: Sends a response packet, then waits for an incoming serial message and handles packet-style commands, treating other bytes as text lines. Returns minus one if nothing arrives and zero for an unknown command.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:10EDA
name: receive_serial_message_with_timeout
description: Waits for an incoming serial message, checking packet-style commands and treating other bytes as text lines. Returns minus one when the deadline expires and zero when an unrecognised command arrives.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:10F12
name: dispatch_serial_text_and_packets
description: Handles incoming serial data by treating low-range bytes as text lines and reading packet-style commands, which are answered when their check value matches. Returns minus one when a message is incomplete.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:10F4C
name: read_serial_text_line
description: Reads a line of text from the serial link into a buffer, terminated at a carriage return, and clears the first byte beforehand. Non-empty lines other than the modem echo command are reported, and packet-style messages arriving in between are handled.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:10F62
name: receive_text_or_packet_message
description: Reads incoming serial data, handling packet-style messages with check values and collecting text lines otherwise. Returns zero when an unknown packet command arrives and minus one when the link goes quiet.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:10FA6
name: send_status_when_flagged
description: When either of two stored status values equals two, prepares a status buffer and sends a fixed two-byte command. Otherwise it does nothing.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:10FEA
name: send_packet_with_two_bytes
description: Builds a short message from a fixed command byte and a length of six, copying two bytes taken from a passed structure into it, then sends the message.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:1101E
name: send_constant_command
description: Places a fixed command byte and a length of five into a message and sends it as one unit.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:11040
name: send_fixed_packet_clear_flag
description: Sends a fixed four-byte packet over the serial link and clears a stored flag.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:11054
name: fill_buffer_with_count
description: Writes counter values as bytes into a buffer, counting down from the given number to zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:11088
name: generate_pseudorandom_value
description: Gets a seed from a library routine, adds a fixed offset, stores the result, and returns its upper fifteen bits as a pseudo-random value.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:1109A
name: store_random_seed_high_word
description: Keeps the upper sixteen bits of its argument in a stored seed value.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:110B2
name: convert_to_uppercase
description: Converts a lowercase ASCII letter to uppercase by subtracting the case difference. Other bytes are returned unchanged.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:110CA
name: convert_to_lowercase
description: Converts an uppercase ASCII letter to lowercase by adding the case difference. Other bytes are returned unchanged.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:1113C
name: initialise_system_and_open_dos
description: Clears a large block of memory, stores the operating-system library base, and opens the DOS library by name. It runs a setup routine when the library opens and raises a system alert when it does not.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:11144
name: do_nothing_stub
description: Empty routine that returns at once with no side effects.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:1127A
name: allocate_port_and_device_state
description: Allocates and clears a block whose size depends on a stored count, sets up a named message structure and two list headers, and opens a device through a library call. Releases what it can and returns if allocation fails.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:1127C
name: split_command_line_into_words
description: Copies a command line into a buffer, splitting it into words at spaces and tabs while keeping quoted text together. Builds an array of pointers to the resulting words.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:1142E
name: build_argument_pointer_array
description: Copies a command text into a new buffer, splitting it into words at spaces, tabs and line breaks while keeping quoted text together. Allocates a pointer array with one entry per word and fills it in.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:11450
name: copy_string_pad_zeros
description: Copies bytes from a source string into a destination buffer up to a count, stopping at the terminator, then fills any remaining bytes of the count with zeros. Returns the destination pointer.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:1147A
name: safe_memory_copy
description: Copies a block of bytes from one place to another, copying backwards when the destination lies above the source so overlapping blocks are handled correctly.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:11480
name: append_string_bounded
description: Appends a source string to the end of a destination string, copying at most 32766 bytes and terminating the result.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:114A4
name: copy_string_with_limit
description: Appends a source string to a destination string, stopping at the terminator or when the count expires. If the count runs out first it writes a terminator at the next byte.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:114D4
name: compare_two_byte_strings
description: Compares two zero-terminated strings byte by byte, up to 32767 characters. Returns minus one if the first is smaller, one if it is larger, and zero if they match.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:114E4
name: copy_string_to_buffer
description: Copies a zero-terminated string into a buffer, including its terminator, and returns the destination pointer.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:11508
name: multiply_32_bit_values
description: Multiplies two 32-bit values by combining the products of their 16-bit halves. Returns the result as a 64-bit value.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:115BA
name: lookup_window_via_icon_library
description: Opens the icon library by name, looks up a window entry through it, and copies two values from that entry into the caller's record. Closes the library afterwards.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:115BC
name: open_timer_and_read_ticks
description: Opens the timer device by name and shows a message that the timer is unavailable if that fails. Otherwise it reads the current time through library calls, closes the device, and returns the total.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:11672
name: read_timer_ticks
description: Reads a timer value through a library routine using a small request structure and returns the sum of its parts. Stores the result in the caller's variable when a pointer is supplied.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:1169A
name: perform_signed_division
description: Divides two signed values by calling an unsigned division routine and negates the quotient when the operands have different signs. Returns the quotient with the second operand kept in the low word.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:116B4
name: negate_result_when_negative
description: Calls a helper routine, then negates its result when the first operand is negative. Returns the adjusted value together with the second argument.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:116C0
name: call_and_return_concatenated
description: Calls another routine and returns a 64-bit value formed from the original second argument and the value the call leaves behind.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:116CA
name: forward_call_and_return
description: Calls one routine with no arguments and returns, passing no values through.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:116F4
name: divide_unsigned_32_bit
description: Divides an unsigned 32-bit value by another, using a sixteen-step shift-and-subtract loop when the divisor is large and direct division otherwise. Returns the quotient and remainder together.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:1171A
name: divide_words_in_registers
description: Runs a sixteen-step shift-and-subtract division on register contents, with the divisor's two words swapped, leaving the quotient and remainder in registers.
